page.title: Archive and billing directory
page.description: Four visible sections. North Pier archive contains preserved collection records; North Pier billing contains active billing records. These are distinct sections.

cases.goal: Open North Pier Details in the North Pier archive.
cases.basis: The archive row is literally North Pier Details; the other Details rows have different location names.

cases.goal: Open the record of visitors arriving at the northern pier's preserved collection.
cases.basis: The northern pier preserved collection is North Pier archive, whose Visitor arrivals log is the only matching record.

cases.goal: Open the North Pier invoice in active billing records, not the archived copy.
cases.basis: The billing row is North Pier invoice; the archive contains an explicitly archived copy.

cases.goal: Open the North Pier annual report; no archive or billing section was specified.
cases.basis: Both North Pier archive and North Pier billing contain an Annual report, so the goal does not select one.
